mainEntity.name: Which garages can use 4XCODE's garage management software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our software is designed for independent garages, automotive repair workshops, mobile mechanics, MOT and service centres, and vehicle repair businesses. Whether you run a single-bay workshop or a busy multi-bay garage, the system adapts to your daily workflow and team size.

mainEntity.name: What daily garage activities can the Garage Management System help manage?

acceptedAnswer.text: The system helps you manage customer records, vehicle histories, bookings, job cards, technician assignments, digital inspections, quotations, customer approvals, invoicing, and service reminders. Reporting tools also give you a clear overview of workshop activity, payments, and performance, all from one connected auto repair garage software platform.

mainEntity.name: How does pricing work for your garage software plans?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our garage management software has three monthly plans: Starter at £99/month, Professional at £175/month and Enterprise at £250/month. Professional includes everything in Starter, plus website integration, enquiry management and sales conversion reports. Enterprise includes everything in Professional, plus unlimited website integrations, inventory management, MOT reminders, a VRM tracker and advanced business analytics.

mainEntity.name: How can my garage start using the Garage Management System?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by booking a demo with our team. We will understand your workshop's requirements, set up your account, and help import your existing customer and vehicle information. Our team then guides your staff through the system so they feel confident using it.

mainEntity.name: Is support available after the software has been set up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our support team helps with technical questions, troubleshooting, and using new features as your garage grows. We also release regular software improvements, and the level of support available depends on the plan you choose for your workshop.
